metas.name: Inside Out
metas.description: Since they loved Inside Out 2, they will love the original emotional and funny journey of Joy and Sadness.

metas.name: Frozen
metas.description: Since they enjoyed Frozen II, they'll love seeing how Elsa and Anna's magical adventure originally began.

metas.name: The Lion King
metas.description: A classic musical adventure that perfectly complements their enjoyment of the sequels and spin-offs.

metas.name: Monsters University

metas.name: Despicable Me 3
metas.description: Continuing the adventures of Gru and the Minions, filled with the same hilarious antics they enjoyed in the first two.

metas.description: A laugh-out-loud comedy focusing on the hilarious yellow Minions they love from Despicable Me.

metas.name: WALL-E

metas.name: Up

metas.name: Kung Fu Panda 3
metas.description: Continues the action-packed and funny martial arts journey of Po that they enjoyed in the first two movies.

metas.name: The Incredibles

metas.name: Cars

metas.name: Megamind

metas.name: Wreck-It Ralph

metas.name: Big Hero 6

metas.name: The Secret Life of Pets

metas.name: Cloudy with a Chance of Meatballs

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania

metas.name: Paddington

metas.name: Paddington 2

metas.name: Abominable

metas.name: The Peanuts Movie

metas.name: Madagascar

metas.name: The Lego Batman Movie
